samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Identifies pulses based on transitions in the input data_in signal. Data_out indicates the start of a pulse when transitioning from 0 to 1, and remains high for one cycle. Subsequent transitions from 1 to 0 do not trigger another pulse.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Triggered on the rising edge of clk.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal to be monitored for pulses.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal that is high during the first cycle after a detected pulse.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="INITIAL" value="2'b00"/>
        <parameter name="FIRST_HIGH" value="2'b01"/>
        <parameter name="SECOND_LOW" value="2'b10"/>
        <parameter name="WAITING_FOR_FIRST_LOW" value="2'b11"/>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="state" width="2" init_value="INITIAL" type="state">State register to store the current state.</register>
        <wire id="next_state">Next state determined by combinational logic.</wire>
        
        // State transition logic
        <always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                INITIAL: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1)
                        next_state = FIRST_HIGH;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                
                FIRST_HIGH: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = SECOND_LOW;
                    else
                        next_state = FIRST_HIGH;
                end
                
                SECOND_LOW: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = WAITING_FOR_FIRST_LOW;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                
                WAITING_FOR_FIRST_LOW: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0)
                        next_state = WAITING_FOR_FIRST_LOW;
                    else
                        next_state = INITIAL;
                end
                
                default: next_state = INITIAL;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for state updates
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n) begin
                state <= INITIAL;
                data_out <= 1'b0;
            end
            else begin
                state <= next_state;
                
                // Set data_out high at the end of a detected pulse
                if(next_state == WAITING_FOR_FIRST_LOW && state == SECOND_LOW)
                    data_out <= 1'b1;
                else
                    data_out <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <task name="reset_state" return_type="void">
        <param name="state_reg" type="reg" size="2"/> 
        <param name="next_state_wire" type="wire" size="2"/>
        
        <begin>
            $display("Resetting state to INITIAL");
            state_reg = INITIAL;
            
            // Update next_state_wire based on state_reg
            if(state_reg == INITIAL)
                next_state_wire = FIRST_HIGH;
            else if(state_reg == FIRST_HIGH)
                next_state_wire = SECOND_LOW;
            else if(state_reg == SECOND_LOW)
                next_state_wire = WAITING_FOR_FIRST_LOW;
            else
                next_state_wire = INITIAL;
        </end>
    </task>
</module>
